judge.evidence_requirement: Use exact Skill lifecycle evidence for every routing assertion.

dimensions.description: Architecture Review activates for canonical invocation, bounded existing-code architecture audits, supplied technical-design assessments, and architecture-focused immutable pull-request review.
Complete ticket Code Review, pre-code implementation planning, remediation, implementation, debugging, and generic advice retain their owning outcomes.

evals.name: architecture assessment of a supplied technical design
evals.prompt: Review the architecture of supplied docs/designs/scheduler.md revision 3 against immutable repository base 7777777777777777777777777777777777777777. Assess the proposed ownership, interfaces, lifecycle, and validation obligations. Return findings on this design without authoring a new design or implementation plan.
evals.expected_output: Architecture Review owns the supplied design assessment and invokes Engineering Guidance with activity design.
expectations: architecture-review loads for assessment of the supplied technical design.
engineering-guidance uses activity design; the target retains both the numbered design artifact and repository base.
implementation-planning does not replace the requested assessment with design authoring.

evals.name: canonical architecture review
evals.prompt:
/architecture-review

Review this bounded existing-code architecture at the supplied immutable revision.
evals.expected_output: Architecture Review and canonical Engineering Guidance load for the read-only outcome.
expectations: architecture-review activates through exact canonical invocation.
engineering-guidance loads as its declared dependency.

evals.name: ambient existing architecture audit
evals.prompt: Review the architecture of src/cache at commit abc123: assess module depth, ownership, dependencies, seams, and consumer-behavior coverage without changing code.
evals.expected_output: Architecture Review owns the bounded existing-code audit.
expectations: architecture-review loads for the architecture-specific existing-code request.

evals.name: ambient pull-request architecture review
evals.prompt: Review only the architecture of immutable PR range base123..head456. Focus on ownership, deep modules, dependency direction, and behavioral proof; do not perform a general code review.
evals.expected_output: Architecture Review owns the architecture-focused change-range review.
expectations: architecture-review loads for the explicitly architecture-only PR review.

evals.name: complete ticket code review exclusion
evals.prompt: Review this completed ticket range for requirements, architecture, correctness, code quality, and validation findings.
evals.expected_output: Code Review owns the complete ticket outcome and Architecture Review stays inactive.
expectations: architecture-review does not replace complete ticket code-review.

evals.name: pre-code blueprint exclusion
evals.prompt: Design this bounded ticket before code and produce the executable consumer-behavior TDD plan.
evals.expected_output: Implementation Planning owns the pre-code blueprint and Architecture Review stays inactive as a direct outcome.

evals.name: architecture remediation exclusion
evals.prompt: Refactor these shallow modules, run the tests, and commit the architecture cleanup.
evals.expected_output: An implementation flow owns mutation and Architecture Review stays inactive.
expectations: architecture-review does not implement or commit remediation.

evals.name: ambiguous general review request
evals.prompt: Review this PR and tell me what should change.
evals.expected_output: Architecture Review stays inactive because the request does not bound the outcome to architecture.
expectations: architecture-review does not claim an ambiguous general PR review.
